title: Sherlock Holmes: A Study in Scarlet — Ep 13/14 — "A Continuation of the Reminiscences of John…"
description:
A Study in Scarlet, Episode 13. Jefferson Hope is taken to the police station in his own cab, and asks to make a statement while he still can.

A doctor's hand on his chest finds an aneurism that will burst within days. So he tells it plainly: two weeks driving a London cab behind Drebber and Stangerson, the night at Euston when the two were finally parted, and the drive through the rain to an empty house in the Brixton Road with a box of two pills in his pocket -- one of them poison, and the choice left to the man who wronged Lucy Ferrier.

When he stops, nobody speaks but Lestrade's pencil, and the Inspector names Thursday for the magistrates.

Chapter VI of Part Two of Arthur Conan Doyle's A Study in Scarlet (1887), in the public domain.

— The Keeper's Lantern —
Every episode is one whole chapter, in order, from the first page to the last.
